# The corpus: every UI correction the Principal made, classified by root cause

*Generated by `node doc/design/corpus/render.js` from `corpus.json`; edit the data, never this file. The study that reads it is
[`../DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`](../DESIGN-SYSTEM.md).*

**What this is.** 311 distinct corrections of something a person sees, touches or hears, made by the Principal in 20 projects between April and November 2026, each with its source and its root cause. 167 quote the Principal's own words, typing kept; the others are marked [paraphrase] because the source records only a session's wording. 117 further records were the same remark relayed in another file and are listed under the record they repeat (`also`). 148 of the 311 name an earlier correction of the same defect.

**How it was read.** Four read-only sweeps on 2026-11-09, merged by hand, then classified by root cause (the default that produced the defect), not by symptom:

- **A**: softanza at fcd3147: memos/, dashboard/CONCLUSIONS.md, mailbox/, protocol/PERCEPTION.md, prompts quoting the Principal
- **B**: the stzlib desk's memory folder (232 files), read whole on 2026-11-09
- **C**: every other project's memory folder (private client studies skipped) and lookout at ad302aa with softanza mailbox/lookout.md
- **D**: stzzui at 1d3448e: doc/AMENDMENT-DOCKET.md, doc/HARVEST-2026-08.md, constitution/rules.json, .central/ inbox and outbox, doc/design/, git log, memory
- **central**: softanza dashboard/zane-ui-corpus-2026-11-09.md (softanza 614d795), read beside the four sweeps

Client projects are named by what they are, not by their names, because this repository is public.
